mentions.name: Ballcast
mentions.description: This service hosts an XGBoost model for MLB totals predictions that runs every thirty minutes, incorporating hyperlocal weather data joined with player attributes provably affected by that weather. It includes a built-in Kelly Criterion calculator as a decision-making tool for bet-sizing, and provides robust historical model evaluations at its validation page. The model still needs some bet-sizing calibration but is close to production-ready.
